source_title: Rule 69O-163.011, F.A.C., Credit Disability Insurance Rates (final adopted version, filed July 26, 2019, effective August 15, 2019; flrules.org notice 22196527)
basis: single premium per $100 of initial insured indebtedness
rate_table_note: Rates are from Table I in paragraph (1)(a), rows for indebtedness repayable in 7-12 and 49-60 months (the table gives term bands from "6 or less" to 109-120 months, plus a rate per month beyond 120). Old rates are from the version effective September 30, 2009 (flrules.org notice 7666606); the proposed rule (notice 21640717, Florida Administrative Register Vol. 45/56, March 21, 2019) shows the same old rates struck through beside the new ones. Monthly outstanding balance rates come from the formula in (1)(b); joint coverage is at most 175% (1)(e); no pre-existing condition limit adds 10% (2)(a)3. The saved file is the Word document published by flrules.org.
summary: Florida lowered its maximum credit disability single premium rates in Rule 69O-163.011, effective August 15, 2019: for 7-12 months, 14-day non-retroactive from $1.13 to $0.90 per $100; for 49-60 months from $3.16 to $2.53. Proposed March 21, 2019 (development notice October 30, 2018) with an amendment to 69O-163.009 on deviations.
